description: Per frame [librosa_centroid_hz, centroid_hz, spectral_flux] from tools/dsp-descriptors-vectors.py, over one segment holding the whole input (mono, frames ending at samples 2048 + 512 k). librosa_centroid_hz uses a periodic Hann window, as librosa.feature.spectral_centroid does; centroid_hz and spectral_flux use the analyzer's symmetric Hann window and the definitions in oscillux.h. A sweep input is amplitude * sin(2 pi f0 T / ln(f1 / f0) * (exp(n / sample_rate_hz / T * ln(f1 / f0)) - 1)) with T = samples / sample_rate_hz.
